name: Product Stack Hero
description: A dark SaaS hero: headline lines blur in, then three CSS-drawn app windows assemble in a pointer-tilted 3D stack, the burndown draws and one block moves.

props.name: headline
props.description: Headline, one string per line; each line blurs in on its own beat.

props.name: emphasis
props.description: Word set in serif italic (emphasis by voice, not colour).

props.name: secondary
props.description: Tour link with a play button.

props.name: rating
props.description: Rating line; a numeric score counts up from zero.

props.name: now
props.description: Current time as a decimal hour, for the now line.

props.name: events
props.description: Calendar blocks: day, start, hours, title, tone (solid, muted, hatch, accent). The accent block is the one the thread moved and lands last.

props.name: sprint
props.type: { name; status; actual: number[]; total; days }
props.description: Burndown data; the line draws and the points-left figure tracks its tip.

props.name: thread
props.description: Comment card data; `moved` is the chip on the last message.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one signal colour: now line, moved block and chip, focus rings.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black stage with graphite windows, or cool grey with white windows.
